_readme: The 30-second Instagram Reel's narration (French), in the same shape as script.json. Bill reads the lines in order, in one take or several; `npm run voice:reel -- <recording(s)>` then rewrites public/audio/reel-narration.wav, src/data/reel-timing.json and public/captions/reel.{srt,vtt}, and the reel follows. Until he records it, src/data/reel-timing.json is hand-authored at a natural French pace and the reel is silent. `clip` groups lines spoken in one breath; `pause` is the silence (s) after a clip; `slot` marks the line Bill may say on camera (public/video/bill-reel.mp4). Keep the ids: the reel's beats refer to them.
prompt: Bill Badran. Guide de la prospérité financière. Planificateur financier.

voice._note: No synthetic voice for the reel: it waits for Bill's own recording (npm run voice:reel). Do not use the ElevenLabs free plan for it: its licence does not allow commercial use.
voice.speaker: Bill Badran (to record)

lines.text: Avant les chiffres, il y a votre vie.
lines.cue: A notebook draws itself. The line is handwritten; a brass underline under « votre vie ».
Two chairs by the lake. The brass line becomes the shoreline.

lines.text: Les gens dont vous prenez soin.
lines.cue: The couple walking along the shore.

lines.text: Un compte ici, une police là, un testament pas revu depuis des années.
lines.cue: Three clippings land one by one: statement, policy, will.

lines.text: Mais qui regarde comment tout s’emboîte ?
lines.cue: The brass line reaches toward the pieces and stops short.

lines.text: J’ai créé un guide : cinq angles morts, des exemples simples, aucun jargon.
lines.cue: Bill as a large taped print; the guide lands; three short notes.

lines.text: Vous n’avez pas besoin de réponses parfaites.
lines.cue: The meadow draws itself; the brass line walks its footpath.

lines.text: Juste un point de départ honnête.
lines.cue: « Un point de départ honnête. » Then the end card.
